title: Harden Network lifecycle UI status
summary: Hardened the Network page UX/status layer by adding read-only lifecycle state to /api/network/workers, a first-viewport runtime banner, state-aware lifecycle buttons, custom confirmed-command dialog, inline worker coordinator URL validation, token posture copy without secret exposure, restart guidance, and focused tests/smokes.
reason: Operators running a small LAN coordinator/worker setup need to distinguish saved configuration from active runtime state, understand why normal Launch is blocked, see coordinator/worker relationship evidence, and avoid unsafe lifecycle commands or invalid worker targets such as 0.0.0.0.
behavior_before: The Network page emphasized route availability and persisted worker evidence, but lifecycle controls used generic labels, confirmed commands used window.confirm, the first viewport did not summarize runtime state/Launch blocking/token posture, and worker URL validation relied on backend preconditions.
behavior_after: The Network page shows configured mode plus runtime status, uses backend lifecycle state to gate relevant coordinator/worker controls, keeps future controls separate and disabled, renders dry-run no-touch evidence first, requires a page-owned confirmation dialog for confirmed commands, blocks obvious invalid worker URLs inline, and keeps token values hidden.
manual_validation: Browser plugin attempted against localhost; Playwright MCP bridge timed out, so repo browser-backed Network smoke is the browser evidence.
Refreshed generated summaries for touched source/test/change-packet files.

Strict change-control validation failed because four unrelated generated dependency-atlas assets are not listed in any unreleased packet: docs/generated/dependency-atlas/assets/dependency_detail_core_library.png, dependency_detail_core_library.svg, dependency_detail_desktop_watch.png, dependency_detail_desktop_watch.svg.
rollback_plan: Revert the additive NetworkWorkersDto/facade fields and the Network WebView HTML/JS/CSS/test changes in this packet. Existing backend lifecycle providers, command routes, processing behavior, queue policy, and media mutation policy are not changed by this pass.
notes: Plan slug: network-ui-lifecycle-status-hardening-2026-06-14. Implementation scope is UX + Status only: read-only status evidence plus WebView clarity; no worker processing, media policy, queue behavior, or stop semantics changes.
